sentences.zh: 该市每年承诺投入20亿美元，确保每个人都有地方栖身。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Amy Julia Harris on how a system meant to help the most vulnerable people in New York has been left open to exploitation and abuse.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事艾米·朱莉娅·哈里斯将探讨旨在帮助纽约最弱势群体的体系是如何陷入被剥削和滥用的局面的。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Amy Julia, how did you first get involved in this story?
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米·朱莉娅，你是怎么开始接触到这个故事的？

sentences.en: In July 2019, I received an anonymous tip that was sent to the New York Times that basically said,
sentences.zh: 2019年7月，我收到了一封发送给《纽约时报》的匿名举报信，大意是说，

sentences.en: you should look into this guy named Victor Rivera, who operates a network of homeless shelters, and look into the way that he treats women and spends money.
sentences.zh: 你们应该调查一个名叫维克托·里维拉的人，他运营着一个收容所网络，并调查他对待女性的方式和资金花销。

sentences.en: So it was a little bit of a vague tip, and that piqued my interest, and I wanted to learn more.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一条有点含糊的线索，但这引起了我的兴趣，我想了解更多。

sentences.en: And who did he turn out to be?
sentences.zh: 他后来被发现是什么人？

sentences.en: So he is the head of a nonprofit called the Bronx Parent Housing Network, which is one of the largest non-profits that operates homeless shelters in New York City.
sentences.zh: 他是布朗克斯父母住房网络（Bronx Parent Housing Network）这一非营利组织的负责人，该组织是纽约市运营无家可归者收容所的最大的非营利组织之一。

sentences.en: The group has received $274 million from the city since 2017.
sentences.zh: 自2017年以来，该组织已从市政府获得了2.74亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow, that's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 哇，那是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a ton, a ton of money.
sentences.zh: 是的，是一大笔，一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And that enormous success is built in part on Victor Rivera's own personal inspiring backstory.
sentences.zh: 而巨大的成功部分建立在维克托·里维拉本人励志的个人背景之上。

sentences.en: Victor, thank you so much for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 维克托，非常感谢你今天加入我们。

sentences.en: Wow, it is really a pleasure and an honor to be sitting here with you.
sentences.zh: 哇，能和你们坐在这里真的非常荣幸。

sentences.en: Victor Rivera talked about his life story on this housing podcast called Realty Speak.
sentences.zh: 维克托·里维拉在一个名为“地产畅谈”的住房播客上谈到了他的人生故事。

sentences.en: Where do you want to start?
sentences.zh: 你想从哪里开始？

sentences.en: Why don't we go back to the beginning?
sentences.zh: 我们何不从头说起？

sentences.en: You know, Bill, the beginning started in 1965 at just the tender age of five years old.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比尔，一切始于1965年，当时我年仅五岁。

sentences.en: I'm from 138th Street and Brook Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我来自138街和布鲁克大道。

sentences.en: As many people know that in the 60s and 70s, 138th Street and Brook Avenue, the heart of the South
sentences.zh: 正如许多人所知，在60和70年代，138街和布鲁克大道，也就是南

sentences.en: Bronx, was probably the most inundated drug den in the country.
sentences.zh: 布朗克斯的核心地带，可能是全国毒窝最泛滥的地方。

sentences.en: And he said that he grew up in a poor neighborhood in the South Bronx.
sentences.zh: 他说他在南布朗克斯的一个贫困街区长大。

sentences.en: At nine years old, the building where I used to live in, 1713 Taylor, became condemned.
sentences.zh: 在我九岁那年，我以前住的泰勒街1713号的建筑被判为危楼。

sentences.en: And my mother had to move into a shelter.
sentences.zh: 我母亲不得不搬进收容所。

sentences.en: And lived in a homeless shelter for a while in the 60s and 70s.
sentences.zh: 并在60和70年代在无家可归者收容所里生活了一段时间。

sentences.en: And what was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: What was the environment there?
sentences.zh: 那里的环境是怎样的？

sentences.en: Scary.
sentences.zh: 很可怕。

sentences.en: Why was it scary?
sentences.zh: 为什么可怕？

sentences.en: You know, there was prostitution, nothing of an environment where a child should be raised.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有卖淫活动，根本不是一个抚养孩子该有的环境。

sentences.en: His mom was a single mother.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一位单亲妈妈。

sentences.en: And he said he grew up in an environment where drugs were very common.
sentences.zh: 他说他成长在一个毒品非常普遍的环境中。

sentences.en: As a kid, he was selling drugs.
sentences.zh: 还是个孩子的时候，他就在贩毒。

sentences.en: I will never glamorize that lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会把那种生活方式浪漫化。

sentences.en: But at that time, that's all I knew.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，那就是我仅知的一切。

sentences.en: And said he ultimately became addicted to crack cocaine himself and became homeless, homeless, was arrested on a drug charge, went to jail, and served a stint in state prison.
sentences.zh: 并称他最终自己也对快克可卡因上瘾，无家可归，因毒品指控被捕，进了监狱，并在州立监狱里服刑了一段时间。

sentences.en: And when he got out, he said he vowed to change his life.
sentences.zh: 当他出狱时，他说他发誓要改变自己的人生。

sentences.en: September 1st, 1990, at 1.34 in the afternoon, I stood in the window of a crack house.
sentences.zh: 1990年9月1日，下午1点34分，我站在一处瘾君子巢穴的窗前。

sentences.en: And I challenged the God of my understanding, who I call Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 我向我所理解的神——我称他为耶稣基督——发出挑战。

sentences.en: And I told him that I could not stop getting high, and that if he was the God that my mother said that he was, that he would take away my desire to ever get high again.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我无法停止吸毒，如果他真的是我母亲所说的那种神，他就会夺走我再次吸毒的欲望。

sentences.en: Until the day of today, he's kept that promise with me.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，他一直对我践行着这个承诺。

sentences.en: And became very involved with God and his church, which is how he started the Bronx Parent Housing
sentences.zh: 并全身心投入到上帝和他的教会中，这正是他在2000年与教会的其他几个人一起创办布朗克斯父母住房

sentences.en: Network with a few other people from his church in 2000.
sentences.zh: 网络的原因。

sentences.en: What I want to tell people is that there is hope, and you have to have love and compassion for people, and not judgment.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉人们的是，希望是存在的，你必须对人抱有爱与同情，而不是评判。

sentences.en: So he said that he's really dedicated his life to helping people who were in a similar situation that he had been in growing up.
sentences.zh: 所以他说他真正致力于帮助那些和他小时候处境相似的人。

sentences.en: There's only hope when you believe and you give someone love and an opportunity.
sentences.zh: 只有当你相信并给予某人爱与机会时，才会有希望。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Bill.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，比尔。

sentences.en: It's been an honor to stay here with you.
sentences.zh: 能在这里陪伴你真是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Victor, beautiful message, amazing story.
sentences.zh: 维克托，信息很美，故事惊艳。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being here today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你今天来到这里。

sentences.en: And we'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。

sentences.en: Until then.
sentences.zh: 在此之前。

sentences.en: That is a very compelling story, a story of salvation and redemption.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常引人入胜的故事，一个关于拯救与救赎的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a very compelling story.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常引人入胜的故事。

sentences.en: And a lot of the people that I talked to said that that really drew them in and struck them.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的许多人都说，这真的吸引了他们并触动了他们。

sentences.en: But in the course of my investigation, I found out that that wasn't the entire story.
sentences.zh: 但在我的调查过程中，我发现这并不是全部的故事。

sentences.en: There was this very robust network of former employees who knew all about Victor Rivera.
sentences.zh: 存在一个非常强大的前员工网络，他们对维克托·里维拉了如指掌。

sentences.en: And, you know, from the very beginning kind of told me, he's not who you think he is.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，从一开始就告诉我，他并不是你想象的那种人。

sentences.en: They kept on hitting on the same theme, which was that Victor Rivera had a problem when it came to women.
sentences.zh: 他们不断提到同一个主题，那就是维克托·里维拉在对待女性方面有问题。

sentences.en: A number of employees told me that Victor Rivera was kind of like the Harvey Weinstein of the
sentences.zh: 多名员工告诉我，维克托·里维拉有点像是无家可归者收容所体系中的哈维·韦恩斯坦，

sentences.en: homeless shelter system and said that he used his position of power to prey on homeless women who were staying in his shelters.
sentences.zh: 并表示他利用自己的权力地位来捕食住在他的收容所里的无家可归女性。

sentences.en: So I spent months tracking down several women who I had heard had to contend with inappropriate comments or sexual harassment or even worse.
sentences.zh: 因此，我花了好几个月的时间追踪采访了几位女性，我听说她们曾不得不面对不当言论、性骚扰甚至更糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: And eventually, through a lot of on-the-ground reporting and phone calls, I found a woman named
sentences.zh: 最终，通过大量的实地报道和电话采访，我找到了一位名叫

sentences.en: Erica Sklar.
sentences.zh: 埃丽卡·斯克拉尔（Erica Sklar）的女性。

sentences.en: And what did Erica Sklar tell you?
sentences.zh: 埃丽卡·斯克拉尔对你说了什么？

sentences.en: Erica told me that she was about 40 years old when she became homeless after she had gotten out of an abusive relationship and needed a new place to stay.
sentences.zh: 埃丽卡告诉我，她在大约40岁时，在摆脱了一段虐待关系并需要找一个新住处后变得无家可归。

sentences.en: And that's when she entered a Bronx Parent Housing Network shelter in 2012.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，她在2012年进入了布朗克斯父母住房网络的一家收容所。

sentences.en: And that's when she met Victor Rivera.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时她遇到了维克托·里维拉。

sentences.en: She said Victor Rivera told her about how he used to be homeless and had kind of turned around his life and had this inspiring life story.
sentences.zh: 她说维克托·里维拉向她讲述了自己曾经如何无家可归、如何扭转了人生并拥有这样一个励志人生故事的经历。

sentences.en: And she was very struck by that.
sentences.zh: 这让她深感震撼。

sentences.en: And she said that instantly put her at ease and she felt very comfortable around him.
sentences.zh: 她说这瞬间让她放松了下来，她在他的身边感到非常自在。

sentences.en: So they remained in touch for the next couple of months until one day Victor Rivera told her, hey, I've got a solution for you.
sentences.zh: 于是他们在接下来的几个月里保持着联系，直到有一天维克托·里维拉告诉她，嘿，我为你找到了一个解决方案。

sentences.en: You can move into my home.
sentences.zh: 你可以搬到我家来。

sentences.en: I live there with my wife.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子住在那里。

sentences.en: Do you want to move in?
sentences.zh: 你想搬进来吗？

sentences.en: And Erica said that at this point, she kind of jumped at that opportunity because she was looking to eventually get out of the shelter system.
sentences.zh: 埃丽卡说，当时她可以说是抓住这个机会，因为她当时正寻求最终离开收容所体系。

sentences.en: There are time limits for how long.
sentences.zh: 对于能够呆多久有时间限制。

sentences.en: You can stay in temporary housing.
sentences.zh: 你可以在临时住房里居住。

sentences.en: And it's really hard to find affordable permanent housing in New York City.
sentences.zh: 而且在纽约市很难找到负担得起的永久住房。

sentences.en: So she thought she was really lucky.
sentences.zh: 所以她觉得自己真的很幸运。

sentences.en: And this seemed like a great solution.
sentences.zh: 这看起来是个极好的解决方案。

sentences.en: And she trusted Victor Rivera.
sentences.zh: 而且她信任维克托·里维拉。

sentences.en: So she moved in in 2013.
sentences.zh: 于是她在2013年搬了进去。

sentences.en: And she said she had a beautiful apartment on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 她说她在三楼有一套漂亮的公寓。

sentences.en: But the problem sort of started with Victor Rivera, whose tone, she said, shifted significantly towards her.
sentences.zh: 但问题是从维克托·里维拉开始的，据她说，他的语气对她发生了显著的转变。

sentences.en: She said that he became very flirtatious and started making inappropriate comments about the way that she looked.
sentences.zh: 她说他变得非常轻浮，开始对她的外表发表不当言论。

sentences.en: You know, he would start pinching her or trying to lift up her shirt, she said.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说他会开始掐她或者试图撩起她的衬衫。

sentences.en: Make comments about how she was very curvy and he liked larger women.
sentences.zh: 发表关于她身材非常丰满、他喜欢体型较胖的女性的言论。

sentences.en: She said that she was very taken aback by this, but was trying to laugh it off and downplay
sentences.zh: 她说她对此感到非常惊愕，但试图一笑了之并淡化此事，

sentences.en: it and just kind of hoped it wouldn't continue up until, you know, one night in December 2016, where she told me that something pretty graphic happened.
sentences.zh: 只是希望这种情况不会持续下去，直到，你知道的，2016年12月的一个晚上，她告诉我发生了一件相当露骨的事情。

sentences.en: She was in her apartment.
sentences.zh: 她在自己的公寓里。

sentences.en: She was by herself.
sentences.zh: 她独自一人。

sentences.en: And her microwave broke and started smoking.
sentences.zh: 她的微波炉坏了，开始冒烟。

sentences.en: So she asked Rivera to come upstairs and help her fix it.
sentences.zh: 所以她请里维拉上楼帮她修一下。

sentences.en: And she said once he came in, he said he wanted to see a leak in her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 她说他一进来就说他想查看她卧室里的漏水情况。

sentences.en: So she was very apprehensive at this point, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说这时候她非常担忧。

sentences.en: But it sounded plausible.
sentences.zh: 但听起来合情合理。

sentences.en: So she went into her bedroom with Victor Rivera.
sentences.zh: 所以她和维克托·里维拉一起进了她的卧室。

sentences.en: And at that point, she said that he turned off the lights and shoved her against a wall and began kissing her.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她说他关上了灯，把她推到墙上并开始吻她。

sentences.en: And he asked her if she liked living in his home and then demanded that she give him oral sex.
sentences.zh: 他问她是否喜欢住在他的家里，然后要求她给他口交。

sentences.en: And she told me at this point as she was crying that she was wondering if she could fight him off or what she should do.
sentences.zh: 她哭着告诉我，当时她在想自己能不能把他推开或者该怎么做。

sentences.en: And she sort of made the split second decision that if she didn't want to be homeless and wanted to keep her housing, she would just go along with this.
sentences.zh: 她做出了一个电光石火般的决定：如果她不想无家可归并想保住住所，她就顺从这一切。

sentences.en: So she said that she did it.
sentences.zh: 所以她说她照做了。

sentences.en: And she described it to me as a sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 她向我描述这是一起性侵犯。

sentences.en: She said that she had never felt so dirty or disgusted and said it was just a horrible bargain that she made.
sentences.zh: 她说她从未感到如此肮脏或恶心，并说这只是一笔她做出的可怕交易。

sentences.en: And after that, she said that she was so traumatized and terrified of what had happened and of Victor
sentences.zh: 在那之后，她说她对发生的事情以及对维克托·里维拉感到如此创伤和恐惧，以至于她在枕头底下藏了一把刀，还在门后顶了一把椅子。

sentences.en: Rivera that she slept with a knife under her pillow and propped a chair against her door.
sentences.zh: 她说她很少离开房间，只是生活在永恒的恐惧中，害怕他会闯进来并试图再次这样做。

sentences.en: She said she rarely left her room and just lived in perpetual fear that he was going to barge in and try to do this again.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 而且当然，他就住在楼下。

sentences.en: And of course, he lives right downstairs.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他就住在楼下。

sentences.en: He lived right downstairs.
sentences.zh: 她说他总是知道她什么时候独自一人。

sentences.en: And she said that he always knew when she was by herself.
sentences.zh: 所以她头上一直悬着一个威胁，可能不得不再次遭受虐待。

sentences.en: So it was just a constant threat hanging over her of having to to maybe be subjected to abuse again.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，她说事情果真如此，维克托

sentences.en: And in the next couple of weeks, she said that's exactly what happened, that Victor
sentences.zh: 里维拉会来到她的房间，继续向她施压要求发生性关系。

sentences.en: Rivera would would come up to her room and continue to pressure her for sex.
sentences.zh: 他要求她和他睡觉，但她说这次她告诉他她不会这么做，而且他是结了婚的人、有妻子，他怎么能做出这种事？

sentences.en: He demanded that she sleep with him, but she said this time she told him that she wasn't going to do it and that he was married and had a wife and how could he do that?
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了。

sentences.en: And she refused.
